table ip nftban {
	comment "nftban-gen=1794257084868951797-375691"
	set blacklist_manual_ipv4 {
		type ipv4_addr
		flags interval,timeout
		comment "nftban-gen=decoy-set-comment"
		elements = { 192.0.2.10, 198.51.100.0/24 timeout 1h expires 1h }
	}

	chain input {
		comment "nftban-gen=decoy-chain-comment"
		type filter hook input priority filter - 10; policy accept;
		ip saddr @blacklist_manual_ipv4 counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
	}
}
